brief:
Hamas warned that Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir's threats to forcibly relocate Gaza's population undermine tentative agreements and damage international mediation efforts, Shehab Wire reported. The group called on international mediators to act urgently to halt what it described as aggression and lift the blockade on Gaza.

Hamas held mediators responsible for taking immediate steps to prevent what the group characterized as threats to the humanitarian agreement. The statement came as negotiations over a ceasefire deal have remained stalled.

title: Hamas says Katz deportation threats destroy ceasefire understandings
